integrity: Exact exhaustive enumeration of all 262144 vertex subsets, integer signed acyclic-Morse chain reductions, unit Smith pivots, direct chain-cycle checks, and independently ordered Smith-normal-form cross-check. Reproducible code and outputs are included.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the integral homology of the single 18-vertex categorical product and rational inclusion barcodes, but neither a uniform theorem in the graph sizes nor a full homotopy classification of its degree-two forest complex. It does not determine integral persistence-module extension classes.
title: Integral homology and rational persistence of the \(K_2\times K_3\times K_3\) forest filtration
